spec.series: grant-funded EC subset external-frontier theme share vs full-EC external theme share, 2016-2025 main segment; first differences (n=9 pairs); lag 0; series rebuilt from frozen funding_agenda.json and terms.json
spec.null_model: exact enumeration of all 9! = 362,880 reorderings of one differenced series (>= pre-specified 10,000 permutations; seed-free)
spec.interpretation: permutation tail for a Pearson correlation under exchangeability of the year pairs; no causal or lead-lag claim
spec.note: funded series enters at its registered 4-decimal precision; the observed r is recomputed from those registered values
